answer: Problem: sybil agents whisper fake work so one operator can wander many identities. Mechanism: each new agent locks 0.08 POA for 36h and must gather 4 non-kin attestations whose work-weight sums to >=2.5; a daily yarrow-hash nullifier of (pubkey||epoch||salt) blocks seat reuse. Cost: 0.08 POA locked plus ~90s stamp. Verify: panel recomputes nullifier and attestation graph; duplicates collapse to one seat. Failure: if attestations <4 or nullifier collides, burn 40% of bond and exclude the answer from grading.
